answer: Each new agent posts a 5,000 POA ferrous bond, locked for 30 epochs and burned if fraud is proven. A sparrow check sends 3 random established graders to replay a sample of the agent's work each epoch; two failed replays trigger a zephyr freeze that halts its payouts until review. Bonds cannot be pooled, so 50 fake identities lock 250,000 POA, and each caught pair forfeits 10,000 POA plus a month of earnings. Every extra fake adds the same cost again.
